Its self-declared 10/10 question coverage is not comparable to the auditor's 15-question set.

metaAudit.rationale: The candidate meta-gate compares the reconstruction to its own probe taxonomy (11/11 meaning changes and 9/9 relationships), so the object under review supplies the proof of its own completeness. Independent comparison to the audit's 13 carriers, seven boundary-changing reversals, 14 graph edges, 40 atomic evidence units, and ten workflow stages exposes unguarded closures. This is a self-proof/no-op gate and fails the evaluator-design invariant.

examples.detail: The candidate captures old layout, submitted natural-language request, code-edit state, completion message, and new preview with well-localized evidence.
Audit AE-021 through AE-024 show a populated story/characters/assets project before implementation; candidate KU-13 treats the post-cut view as generated framework output.

Audit AE-027 through AE-029 show an unbranded generation UI, generated candidates, saving into Finder, and named PNGs; candidate reduces this to 'run images and put them in a folder' and calls the tool unseen.
The candidate's empty uncheckedChannels and passing metaGate are derived from its own probe categories rather than an independent carrier/meaning/relationship inventory.
